top_paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a popular class of large language models (LLMs), offering high efficiency and accuracy. However, in KV-cache-intensive serving scenarios, MoEs often exhibit a tension between the GPU memory requirements of the model weights and the growing KV cache. We propose PagedWeight, a novel management method for MoE LLM serving that dynamically quantizes MoE model's weights at runtime and balances expert-weight precision with the KV cache sizes. top_paper.llm_reason: PagedWeight（Yang/Zhao/Dasgupta/Misailovic，UIUC 量化/系统组）直击 MoE LLM 推理服务最痛的内存矛盾：在 KV-cache 密集场景下，专家权重与不断增长的 KV cache 争抢 GPU 显存。论文→理论层面，它把'权重精度'从静态超参重构为运行时可调的资源杠杆——按需动态量化专家权重、用省下的显存换更大的 KV cache 窗口，实质是用'精度换容量'的帕累托调度；工程实践层面，该方法可直接嵌入任何 vLLM/SGLang 类 MoE 推理框架：在长上下文/高并发场景下，默认让冷门专家走低精度、热门专家走高精度，并把回收的显存还给 KV cache 池，从而在不加 GPU 的前提下提升可服务并发数与最大上下文长度；趋势层面，2026 年 MoE 已成主流架构（DeepSeek/Mixtral/Qwen-MoE），但'显存墙'取代'算力墙'成为服务瓶颈，精度-显存动态权衡是明确上升线。证据为方法设计与系统抽象自述（质量感知量化），工程目标（权重精度 vs KV cache 大小的平衡）清晰可验证。短板：无代码/benchmark 链接（待核验），动态量化的精度损失阈值、量化/反量化的运行时开销、与具体 MoE 模型的吞吐提升幅度均为关键待验项。在今日数据中落地性最强，故评为即时价值。

top_papers.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
top_papers.abstract: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its value for reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training remains unclear. We study vanilla Muon in sparse-reward agentic RL through matched single-seed comparisons with AdamW on ALFWorld using Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. Under Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), applying Muon only to hidden weight matrices raises final-window validation success from 0.290 to 0.546 (+88%); high-rate AdamW controls retain no post-update success. The
top_papers.llm_reason: When Does Muon Help Agentic RL?（Ruan/Lin/Huang/Zhou/Wei）回答了一个高度实操的问题：在稀疏奖励的 Agentic RL 后训练中，Muon 优化器相比 AdamW 到底有没有用？论文→理论层面，它把'Muon vs AdamW'的争论从'预训练阶段（Muon 已证明有竞争力）'推进到'后训练/RL 阶段（尚不清晰）'，并给出有对照的实证——在 ALFWorld 上用 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct + GiGPO，仅对隐藏权重矩阵施用 Muon 使验证成功率从 0.290 提升到 0.546（+88%），而高学习率 AdamW 对照组训练后成功率为零；工程实践层面，这对任何做 Agent RL 后训练的团队都是即插即用的实验线索：可立即在自有的 RLHF/Agentic RL 流水线上对照 Muon（仅 2D 权重）vs AdamW，验证收益是否可复现、是否随模型规模保持；趋势层面，优化器选择是 RL 后训练工程化的基础杠杆，且'仅对特定权重矩阵用 Muon'这种选择性策略本身是一种可迁移的训练工程模式。证据为单种子对照实验、具体数字、具体模型/基准，透明度高（虽为单种子，需多种子确认）。短板：无代码链接（待核验），0.5B 规模的结论能否外推到更大模型、多种子方差、其他 Agent 基准上的表现均为关键待验项。落地路径清晰且证据具体，评为即时价值。

top_papers.title: An Exam for Active Observers
top_papers.abstract: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for ML
